tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which of the following is a strong base?

solution.text: Order of basic character is $\mathrm{NH}_{3}>\mathrm{PH}_{3}>$ $\mathrm{AsH}_{3}>\mathrm{SbH}_{3} .$ Basic-character decreases down the group from $\mathrm{N}$ to Bi due to increase in atomic size.
